facts.text: Safety Beach earned its name after a 1836 trading vessel ran aground, and the crew safely unloaded livestock, sparking the town’s nickname.
Road construction in the 1930s formalised the Dromana Esplanade, improving vehicle access along the foreshore and linking Safety Beach to the peninsula.
Martha Cove, a large inland harbour, evolved into a thriving residential community after overcoming early financial difficulties.
The Safety Beach Sailing Club, founded in 1967, has hosted state and national regattas, earning recognition across Australia’s sailing community.
The foreshore reserve features a charming children’s playground and shaded BBQ areas, offering a relaxed spot for families along the bay.
